name: CFlux Cartoon (Lora)
description: Explore the creative universe where AI art meets music and support an independent artist! On my DeviantArt , Mage , and Tungsten accounts, you'll discover a diverse collection of AI-generated artwork, ranging from vibrant fantasy scenes to futuristic concepts and dreamlike visuals. Whether you're into abstract compositions or detailed character design, my gallery offers a unique blend of creativity and cutting-edge technology. For those who want to dive deeper into my sonic world, head over to my SoundCloud to explore "Front Porch Philosophy," my Comedy Country album that combines humor, heart, and storytelling. And don't miss my upcoming AI K-pop project, Vyx , with her new album "NeoN" dropping soon—a bold mix of sharp lyrics, captivating beats, and groundbreaking AI artistry. If you enjoy my work and want to support me financially, you can: 💠 Buy prints and exclusive downloads on DeviantArt . 💠 Donate directly via Ko-Fi to fuel future creations and get exclusive updates on what I'm working on. 💠 Gift me Buzz on Civitai to help me expand my creative tools. Every purchase or donation directly supports my journey as an independent creator, helping me continue to push the boundaries of art and music. Thank you for your support! This lora is made using around 30 images from MarigoldXL which you can find here From my brief testing it does get very close to how MarigoldXL looks but due to it being on Flux doesn't look fully there, which is to be expected. V2 is made using a more balanced dataset of 45 images. It's been trained on Schnell but works well on both Dev and Schnell, if using Dev I'd recommend to run it with the hyper-16 lora at 18 steps. V3 was trained on Dev using 133 images. I would suggest using Euler Simple at 20 steps. V3 is going to be a bit of a project. I intend to increase it dataset, increase it's knowledge and anatomy. I want to give a lot of credit to Joachim and KOPF-KI-NO for helping teach me how to train as well as providing advice and guidance. If you'd like to support me then why not check out my DeviantArt here you can support me by buying a premium download or buying any of my premium galleries. I updated daily (except Sunday) and use a variety of different styles. So if you like what you see then head on over. https://www.deviantart.com/consistentfactorcf
